home.summary: The build has all eleven designed sections in the right order and the interactions the handoff asks for (CTA links, accordion with aria-expanded, first item open), but it is a loose re-interpretation rather than a match: SSIM 0.64, 32.5% of pixels differ, and the page is 7052px against 6814px. findings.title: Build-only capability claims the repo cannot back (NDI 5, alpha, Wirecast, 4K, 60fps, internal NFR ids)
findings.figma: Figma's NDI copy says 'NDI source for OBS or vMix', 'NDI output - broadcast to OBS, vMix, or another machine'; it draws '1920 × 1080' only; no 'NDI 5', no alpha, no Wirecast, no 4K, no 60fps.
findings.build: 'Direct NDI 5 broadcast streams to OBS, vMix, and Wirecast with transparent lower thirds' (feature card, HomeView.vue:183), 'NDI 5 Stream · Alpha Channel' and 'Display 2 · 1920x1080 · 60fps' (OutputManagerMockup.vue:19,43), 'Full 4K resolution' and 'Direct IP feed with alpha channel transparency' (HomeView.vue:243,251), 'NDI 5 direct broadcast streaming' (Pro bullet), 'Hardware frame buffer holds the last-good image' and '(NFR-024)/(NFR-015)' shown to visitors (:207,:214), 'zero lag' (:221), 'Whisper AI' (:188).
findings.evidence: crates/selahcue-desktop/Cargo.toml:43 'grafton-ndi (Apache-2.0; NDI SDK 6). OFF by default' and ADR-0013 ('6.x EULA'), so 'NDI 5' is wrong; video_sink.rs sends RGBA frames but the transparent-output path is only a spike (ADR-0004 S3, FR-048 R2); Wirecast appears nowhere in docs or code outside the marketing views; PRD NFR-005 1080p60 is R2 and spike-gated, MVP floor is 1080p30 / 720p60 (PRD section 30); no 4K target anywhere; the 'zero-blank hardware buffer' is an engine software last-frame hold (selahcue-engine/tests/test_fault.rs). Verified as BACKED: never-blank (NFR-024 + fault matrix), offline operation (NFR-015), platforms Windows/macOS/mobile (G-2, NFR-014, CI matrix), NDI as an optional sink for OBS/vMix (ADR-0013, ndi feature).
findings.decision: Owner (binding rule: honest content wins): remove 'NDI 5', alpha / transparent lower thirds, Wirecast, 4K, 60fps, 'zero lag', 'hardware', the NFR ids and 'Whisper AI' from the copy and mock sub-lines; describe NDI only as 'NDI output for OBS or vMix' and only if the shipped installer includes the NDI runtime (ADR-0013 legal gate OD-06/08 is still open).

findings.title: Figma's own small coloured text fails AA (brand ink, LIVE, white initials on green and gold)
